title: Personalised machine learning alert system evaluated prospectively in a paediatric ICU
summary: The P-WIN alert system estimated deterioration risk at 30-minute intervals for 1,005 PICU patients between January and April 2026. It detected 73% of 99 critical deterioration events in 62 patients 1 to 24 hours ahead, against 39% for the existing PICU Warning Tool. The study is single-centre.
ai_technology: Personalised real-time machine learning alert system (P-WIN)
organization: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia; University of Pennsylvania

evidence.tested: Real-time detection of critical deterioration events in a prospective cohort compared with an existing warning tool.
evidence.unknown: Single centre; effect on patient outcomes not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning model scoring deterioration risk from electronic health record data.
